name: Airbnb
description: Airbnb is a marketplace for stays, services, and experiences; its documented software connections are designed primarily for approved host property-management and channel-management products.
agentUseSummary: Airbnb cannot yet be connected through Relay. Airbnb documents approved host software partners that can manage listings, availability, pricing, reservations, and guest workflows, but the current public material does not establish a generic delegated guest API for searching, booking, paying, messaging, or managing a personal trip. Product and commercial owners must select and obtain acceptance for the host-software use case or keep guest activity in Airbnb.

blocked.label: Connect Airbnb
blocked.description: Connect remains unavailable until Relay selects a supported host or guest product and Airbnb accepts the corresponding authority contract.

blocked.label: Read Airbnb data
blocked.description: Profiles, identities, listings, calendars, prices, availability, reservations, trips, guests, hosts, messages, reviews, payouts, and payment data remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Manage hosting
blocked.description: Publishing, merging, syncing, pricing, opening or blocking dates, accepting reservations, messaging guests, and changing host or listing settings are blocked before software-partner acceptance.

blocked.label: Manage guest bookings
blocked.description: Searching, reserving, paying, cancelling, changing trips, messaging hosts, reviewing, or purchasing stays, services, and experiences is blocked without a published delegated guest contract.

blocked.label: Use private or raw Airbnb interfaces
blocked.description: Private APIs, scraping, browser or device automation, cookie or credential capture, arbitrary requests, and endpoints inferred from Airbnb applications are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No Airbnb action is enabled until the product boundary is frozen, Airbnb grants the relevant partnership, and the complete data, consent, booking, messaging, payment, and revocation contract passes representative acceptance.

runtimeSupport.description: No Airbnb wrapper is mounted before the host-software-versus-guest product and partnership boundary is frozen.

providerSetup.blocker: Airbnb's current public software material describes approved PMS and channel-manager partners serving hosts. A host grants connected software permission, selects listings to publish or synchronize, and can remove the provider under Connected Apps; connected software can create and manage listings subject to Airbnb's software-connected host and regional policies. This is materially different from a guest assistant that searches inventory, books and pays, manages trips, messages hosts, or posts reviews. The current public material reviewed here does not publish a self-service developer enrollment, guest OAuth scopes, guest booking endpoints, credential lifecycle, quotas, or sandbox for that generic use case.
providerSetup.nextAction: Product, commercial and security owners should decide whether Airbnb means host property-management software or a non-API guest handoff. If the host path is selected, the exclusive provider-console lane must obtain written Airbnb software-partner acceptance and the confidential technical, certification, data-protection and revocation contract. Representative acceptance must verify host and listing selection, sync modes, listing creation and merge safety, calendar and price conflicts, reservation lifecycle, guest-PII minimization, messaging and review policy, payments and payouts separation, regional registration, webhook idempotency, disconnect, and post-revocation denial before Connect is enabled.

evidence.supports: Airbnb presents approved software partners as property-management and channel-management products for hosts and measures preferred partners against technical and performance benchmarks.
Airbnb documents that hosts grant PMS or channel-manager software permission, select listings, publish or merge them, and must comply with software-connected host policies.
Airbnb documents listing-level disconnection and account-level removal of a former software provider under Connected Apps, establishing explicit host-controlled revocation.
Airbnb describes Channel Manager connectivity as host-authorized software that maps listing IDs and distributes property data such as availability and pricing.
Airbnb documents regional, property-type and city-registration constraints for listings created through software connections, including cases requiring licensed API partners or manual host action.
